source.modifications: None; original UTF-8/LF content retained. Repository checkout may normalize line endings.

license.modifications: Only a final LF added to the license file; complete notice text unchanged.
license.attribution: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Fire Research Division Experimental Database. Full repository notice retained. No FSRI data imported.

Time.meaning: Time relative to ignition; negative pre-ignition samples retained
Time.locator: TN 1603 section 2.5, printed p.33 / local PDF p.47

Mass1.meaning: Load cell 1, center pan; reduced mass signal, NOT a nonnegative emission rate
Mass1.locator: TN 1603 Appendix A, printed p.145 / local PDF p.159: channel 62 Mass1, kg, center burner. Section 2.1.4 p.9 and section 3.2 p.40

experiment.fuel_reported: Heptane; approximately C7H16, not a batch-specific composition certificate
experiment.initial_mass_status: Nominal value in Table 3.1, not substituted for Mass1 at ignition
experiment.scope: Free-burning liquid pool in an underventilated ISO 9705 room. Not solid furniture pyrolysis.

energy_basis_review.locator: TN 1603 p.41 versus Table 6.1 p.115 and Table 6.2 p.125; cites SFPE Handbook 2002
energy_basis_review.limitation: Do not average these values or import as released-vapor chemical energy. Fuel phase, vaporization accounting, batch and uncertainty require an explicit thermochemical contract.

audit_window_purpose: Predeclared diagnostics: growth/bulk depletion, report steady-state window, and tail. Not an acceptance filter or a chosen calibration interval.
